Editorial policy · Updated 23 July 2026

How we create and maintain Intextify content

Purpose and independence

Our guides are written to help readers understand construction-planning concepts and prepare better questions for professionals. We do not publish supplier claims as fact without context, and commercial relationships do not determine our conclusions.

Sources and calculations

Where an article uses calculations, it explains the assumptions, units, and limitations. Market-rate examples are illustrative unless a page explicitly identifies their date, location, and source. Users should obtain current written quotes before buying materials or signing a contract.

Review and updates

We review articles for accuracy, usefulness, and clarity before publication. Pages show their publication or update date. When a material correction is needed, we update the page and invite readers to report errors through our contact page.

Professional advice

Construction decisions can affect safety, cost, and legal compliance. Our content is educational and is not a substitute for advice from an appropriately qualified engineer, architect, contractor, lawyer, or local authority.

Contributed content

Guest submissions must be original, useful, attributable, and free of undisclosed promotional links. We may edit, decline, or remove submissions that do not meet these standards.
